meta.title: The Explorers' Last Trip
meta.textType: story: a trip to the small zoo, with a map and a key

paragraphs: On Saturday, March thirteenth, the bus left the school gate at half past eight. It took the Explorers to the small zoo, and they arrived at nine o'clock. Teacher Kim stood at the entrance with Lily, Mia, Leo, May, and the other Explorers. A tour guide in a green vest waited for them with a map board. "Welcome to the small zoo," she said. "The new bird house was opened today."

Each pair was given a zoo map with a key. The key showed a bird house, a gibbon house, a pond, a cafe, and an exit. "Here are the directions," said the guide. "First, go to the bird house." "Then take the left-hand path, and walk past the cafe." "After that, go straight on to the pond." "Be careful at the crossing, because the little train runs there." "Finally, meet at the pond at eleven o'clock."

Leo and May went to the bird house first. Many visitors were sightseeing there. Then Leo held up the map, but he held it upside down. "It is this way," he said, and he took a path under some trees. They walked for ten minutes, and they came to a gate with a chain. A sign on the gate said "STAFF ONLY." A worker rode past on a scooter. "Is this the path to the pond?" asked May. She looked at the map and turned it around.

Lily and Mia took the left-hand path from the bird house. They walked past the cafe, which was crowded with visitors, and they turned the corner. At the crossing, they waited, and the little green train went by. Then they walked straight on, and they came to a pond with a small wooden bridge. They were the first pair at the pond, so they sat on a bench and waited. By eleven o'clock, the other pairs stood at the pond, but Leo and May were not there. Teacher Kim looked at her watch, and then she looked at the path again. "Where are they?" asked Lily. Mia said nothing, and she held her camera.

"Oh," said Leo, "now I see it." He and May walked back to the bird house. First, they took the other path, and they passed the cafe. Next, they waited at the crossing and went straight on. Finally, at ten past eleven, they came to the pond. "Here we are!" said May. Teacher Kim smiled, and she said nothing about the time.

Mia put her camera on the little bridge and set the timer. Teacher Kim and the four friends stood in a line by the pond. The camera clicked, and the photo was taken. "This is our last trip," said Teacher Kim. Nobody said a word. Leo took the green flag with a paw print out of his bag. He held it up with a small smile.
text.summary: The Explorers go on their last trip, to the small zoo. Lily and Mia reach the pond first, but Leo and May take a different path and arrive late. At the pond, Teacher Kim says that this is the last trip.
